items.title: AMD CEO Su on earnings outlook, new Starbucks holiday menu, and Hilton CEO on hotel demand
items.summary:
Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi tackles the biggest news of the market day, including AMD's (AMD) earnings outlook topping estimates as chip demand soars, what the blue wave in Congress means for a market rally, and how Starbucks (SBUX) plans its business around the holiday season with new products. 

Sozzi also goes 1-on-1 with Hilton (HLT) CEO Chris Nassetta to discuss AI's impact on the hospitality industry.
